info.name: Id Repo Draft (identity-service)
info.description:
Postman collection for IdRepoDraftController (MOSIP id-repository, id-repository-identity-service).

Base path: /idrepository/v1/identity/draft (port 8090).

Set `baseUrl` and `authToken` variables. All endpoints require `Authorization` cookie.

variable.description: Service base URL. For deployed envs: https://<env-domain> + same path.
JWT from authmanager (clientidsecretkey: clientId=mosip-idrepo-client, appId=idrepo). Sent as Authorization cookie.
Sample UIN (10-digit). Replace with a UIN existing in your environment.
Auto-filled by collection pre-request script. Do not set manually.

request.description: POST /draft/create/{registrationId} — creates a draft. UIN query param optional. Role: postdraftcreateregistrationId.
PATCH /draft/update/{registrationId} — updates draft demographic/documents. Role: patchdraftupdateregistrationId.
GET /draft/publish/{registrationId} — publishes the draft into ID repo. Role: getdraftpublishregistrationId.
DELETE /draft/discard/{registrationId} — discards the draft. Role: deletedraftdiscardregistrationId.
HEAD /draft/{registrationId} — 200 if draft exists, 204 otherwise. Role: draftregistrationId.
GET /draft/{registrationId} — fetches the draft; optional biometric extraction format params. Role: getdraftregistrationId.
PUT /draft/extractbiometrics/{registrationId} — triggers biometric template extraction for the draft. Role: putdraftextractbiometricsregistrationId.
GET /draft/uin/{UIN} — returns draft info for a UIN. Role: getdraftUIN.
